proof_body:
by
  intro R A B C X _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ f g hf hfg
  constructor
  · intro k l hkl
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    exact hf (LinearMap.congr_fun hkl x)
  · intro h
    constructor
    · intro hh
      have hmem : ∀ x, h x ∈ LinearMap.range f := fun x => (hfg (h x)).1 (LinearMap.congr_fun hh x)
      refine ⟨(LinearEquiv.ofInjective f hf).symm.toLinearMap.comp (h.codRestrict (LinearMap.range f) hmem), ?_⟩
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro x
      exact congrArg Subtype.val ((LinearEquiv.ofInjective f hf).apply_symm_apply ⟨h x, hmem x⟩)
    · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro x
      exact (hfg _).2 ⟨k x, rfl⟩
